howToPlay: Keep your distance from enemies to deal maximum damage with your long-range shots. Use your Super to jump away and escape when opponents get too close. Utilize gadgets to control enemy movement or land guaranteed hits.
gears: Equip Damage for higher impact, Shield for extra survival, and Speed to help navigate bushes while maintaining your range.
trait: This brawler is perfect for players who excel at precision, positioning, and maintaining distance.
